# Bitbucket Trigger

## Summary

Learn how to use the Bitbucket Trigger node in n8n.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/trigger-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.bitbuckettrigger.md

---

Learn how to use the Bitbucket Trigger node in n8n. Follow technical documentation to integrate Bitbucket Trigger node into your workflows.

[Bitbucket](https://bitbucket.org/) is a web-based version control repository hosting service owned by Atlassian, for source code and development projects that use either Mercurial or Git revision control systems.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Credentials**

Refer to the [Bitbucket credentials documentation](/integrations/builtin/credentials/bitbucket) for authentication information for this node.
{% endhint %}

{% hint style="info" %}

For usage examples and templates to help you get started, refer to n8n's [Bitbucket Trigger integrations](https://n8n.io/integrations/bitbucket-trigger/) page.
{% endhint %}
